stage1.title: VireMusic is live
stage1.body1: This is Stage 1 — Friends & Family. You can already listen to artists, build playlists, like tracks, and start the Wave — a stream tuned to your taste.
stage1.body2: Direct sales and paying artists directly are coming in the next stage. Thanks for being here from the start.

auth.body1: To comply with Russian law (Federal Law 406), we removed sign-in via Google and Telegram — Russian sites can no longer use foreign authorization services.
auth.body2: You can now sign in with email and password, an email link, or via Yandex.
auth.body3: If you used to sign in with Google or Telegram, choose "Sign in with email link" on the sign-in page, then set a password in your profile under "Sign-in methods".
